action.objective: Broad depth-4 scan of all legal White moves to identify best replies to Black's king on e7.
action.rationale: Fresh position after Black's Ke7. White king on c1 is not in check; no castling rights. Need complete root coverage before selecting a candidate. Rooks on d2/h1, bishop e2, queen g4 are active; Black king exposed on e7 with rook h8 and bishop g7. Use half the node budget for this initial depth-4 scan.
